greeting: Velka Ironhand regards you without hurry. (Master of the Concordant Bazaar)

nodes.npcText: Velka treats every price as a story whose middle she's writing. She is generous with her time and ruthless with her terms. She loathes liars and tolerates haggling as artisan craft.
I am Velka Ironhand, Master of the Concordant Bazaar. warm, peppered with bazaar idioms, slips in numbers without warning

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
